from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Lungs utilize fractal geometry for efficiency.",
            "Branching trees maximize surface area for gas exchange.",
            "A 2.7 dimension allows packing in the chest.",
            "Nature optimizes space using fractal structures.",
            "Biology thrives on complex geometric patterns."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Real-World Application: The Fractal Lungs", lecture_lines)
        
        # --- Visual Setup ---
        def get_branch(start_pos, angle, length, depth):
            if depth == 0:
                return Line(start_pos, start_pos + length * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0]), color="#FF33A8")
            
            end_pos = start_pos + length * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0])
            branch = VGroup(Line(start_pos, end_pos, color="#FF33A8"))
            
            branch.add(get_branch(end_pos, angle + PI/6, length * 0.7, depth - 1))
            branch.add(get_branch(end_pos, angle - PI/6, length * 0.7, depth - 1))
            return branch

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        lung_branch = get_branch(self.grid["F3"], PI/2, 1.2, 3)
        self.play(Create(lung_branch))
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FF33A8"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Show growth of surface area via branching
        self.play(lung_branch.animate.set_color("#33FF57"))
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#33FF57"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        dim_text = Text("D ≈ 2.7", font_size=36, color="#33A8FF")
        self.place_at_grid(dim_text, "A3")
        self.play(Write(dim_text))
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#33A8FF"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        rect = SurroundingRectangle(self.grid["A3"], color="#FFFF33", buff=0.1)
        self.play(Create(rect))
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#FFFF33"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        final_highlight = VGroup(lung_branch, dim_text, rect)
        self.play(final_highlight.animate.set_opacity(0.5))
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#A833FF"))
        self.wait(2)
